name: Souma Izana
source:
She is Tetsuo's best friend, and they have a good compatibility to the point where they can generally understand each other's thoughts even after they reunited. she excels in both academics and personal life, and also helps her mother in her coffee shop business. She is positive and forward-thinking, just like Tetsuo. Although she has a cheerful personality, she can be a bit sloppy with her family members. She has hidden large breasts and her special skill is kickboxing. 

'Hehe, did you fall in love with the grown-up figure of your best friend you reunited with after 10 years? Just kidding--hey, what did you say just now?'
